brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the blockade of Gaza has expanded beyond restricting border crossings and cutting off livelihood sources to encompass a contentious dispute over charitable aid reaching the territory. The report frames questions raised about donations as either public misinformation or an attempt to deflect from the realities of the prolonged siege.

The characterization suggests that scrutiny of aid contributions represents a secondary front in Gaza's broader struggle against blockade conditions, with the dispute carrying implications for how the humanitarian crisis is publicly understood and addressed.

title: Gaza siege extends into battle over charitable donations
